estimates.alt: Change in police-recorded accidents in years 1–3 after a bypass opened, relative to towns still waiting for theirs, in per cent, with 90 and 95 % intervals: Q1 inside the town and Q2 for the whole municipality, then each registered check. Q1 and Q2 have intervals that include zero; the check on all accidents with damage-only included lies on the positive side, the checks on killed or seriously injured, the old through road and class I roads lie below zero.
